Jamun Seed Powder Price: Bulk Jamun Seed Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Jamun seed powder is made from the dried seeds of the Indian jamun fruit (Syzygium cumini) and is bought by herbal, supplement and functional food brands. If you are comparing a jamun seed powder price per kg for commercial formulations, Tradenest Naturals can quote for trial and bulk volumes. We manufacture and export the powder from Surat, India, and keep the specification consistent from one batch to the next. That consistency is what most of our repeat buyers look for in a bulk jamun seed powder supplier.

Why Choose Our Wholesale Jamun Seed Powder?

The seeds are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, then cleaned, dried and fine milled. Our jamun seed powder wholesale grade is a plain seed powder, not an extract, which keeps labelling simple for your finished product. Moisture and mesh are checked on each batch. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.
  • Single-Ingredient Powder: No added fillers, carriers, colours or preservatives.
  • Optimized Mesh Size: Fine milled to 80-100 mesh for smooth blending in formulations.
  • Strict Quality Control: Produced in an FSSAI licensed facility with batch traceability.
  • Scalable Supply: A 5 Kg MOQ suits new brands, while regular bulk volumes suit established buyers.

Common Applications in Modern Industries

The powder works well in a range of commercial products. Supplement companies use it in capsules and tablets. Herbal brands add it to tea blends, powder mixes and traditional Ayurvedic and herbal formulations. Its bitter, astringent taste makes it better suited to capsules and blended products than to plain drinks.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for jamun seed powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Samples are available on request before you place a larger order. What certifications and quality standards apply? We are an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We supply HDPE drums, sealed bulk bags and custom private label packs. Shelf life is 24 months when stored cool and dry. Moisture is 7% or less. What is the lead time for export orders? Lead time depends on order volume, packaging and destination, and we confirm it with each quotation. Contact us to request a quote or a product sample.
